name: QG-I1542: The workflow timeline, details, side panel and listing agree on the status
description:
Objective: The workflow timeline, details, side panel and listing agree on the status.
Preconditions: Kesef CRM QA at the configured origin; authorized test account; an existing application in the needed state discovered read-only, or an unsaved intake whose writes are blocked.
Steps:
1. Follow the reproduction steps of QG-I1542.
2. Evaluate the encoded checks in `test_workflow_timeline_and_status_agree_everywhere`.
3. Record any mismatch as a normal failure; do not skip, xfail or weaken the assertion.
Expected: 1. The workflow timeline, details, side panel and listing agree on the status.
2. The bug's expected result holds; no unintended record or state residue on shared applications.
